not_covered_or_unclear.title: Appliances the tenant owns (e.g. their own washer, dishwasher)
not_covered_or_unclear.plain_rule: If the tenant bought the appliance, the landlord usually doesn't have to fix it. If the landlord supplied it, ask them to repair it.
not_covered_or_unclear.notes: The Order Number list has no order for washers/dishwashers. Mark 'unclear' unless the tenant says who owns it. A LEAK from it can still be a water-leak issue.

not_covered_or_unclear.title: One stove burner not working
not_covered_or_unclear.plain_rule: A broken part of a landlord-supplied stove may fall under 'repair the broken or defective' item; no specific order exists for a single burner.
not_covered_or_unclear.notes: Map to broken_fixture (501) if the stove came with the apartment; say 'likely' at most.

not_covered_or_unclear.title: Noisy or slow appliance
not_covered_or_unclear.plain_rule: Noise or slowness alone isn't listed as a housing code violation. You can still ask your landlord.
